name: Game Chest: Logic Games
summary: Game Chest: Logic Games Edition gives you the chance to play the classic games: Chess, Sudoku and Minesweeper in an attractive, unified environment. In addition to playing updated versions of these all-time favorites on a sweet new phone, Game Chest: Logic Games Edition is filled to the brim with exciting rewards to keep you coming back. As you advance through Game Mastery ranks, you can also challenge your friends to matches in Chess as well as earn spins on the Big Wheel that help boost your progress even more.
